task_blocker.name: task_blocker
task_blocker.value: length("tasks"."blocked_reason") <= 500 AND ("tasks"."waiting_on_id" IS NULL OR length("tasks"."blocked_reason") > 0)

task_completion.name: task_completion
task_completion.value: ("tasks"."status" = 'done' AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("tasks"."status" != 'done' AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL)

checklist_values.name: checklist_values
checklist_values.value: length("checklist_items"."title") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "checklist_items"."completed" IN (0,1) AND "checklist_items"."version" > 0

email_values.name: email_values
email_values.value: "email_outbox"."kind" IN ('reset','digest') AND "email_outbox"."status" IN ('pending','sending','sent','failed') AND "email_outbox"."attempts" BETWEEN 0 AND 6

preference_values.name: preference_values
preference_values.value: "notification_preferences"."assignments" IN (0,1) AND "notification_preferences"."mentions" IN (0,1) AND "notification_preferences"."due_reminders" IN (0,1) AND "notification_preferences"."daily_digest" IN (0,1) AND "notification_preferences"."reminder_hour" BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND "notification_preferences"."version">0

context_revision_values.name: context_revision_values
context_revision_values.value: "context_revisions"."version" BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND length("context_revisions"."title") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length("context_revisions"."body") BETWEEN 1 AND 6000 AND length("context_revisions"."change_note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND "context_revisions"."state" IN ('active','retired') AND length("context_revisions"."input_hash")=64

task_context_brief_values.name: task_context_brief_values
task_context_brief_values.value: "task_context_briefs"."context_sequence">=0 AND "task_context_briefs"."task_version">0 AND length("task_context_briefs"."fingerprint")=64 AND length("task_context_briefs"."task_hash")=64 AND length("task_context_briefs"."input_hash")=64 AND octet_length("task_context_briefs"."payload") BETWEEN 1 AND 131072
